title: Section Title
description: The live site's `.lsx-title` — the heading that opens almost every section. Uppercase heading face at bold, centred, in neutral-700, followed by an 80x2px accent-500 rule. That gold rule is the single most repeated device in the design: it appears under the section title on the homepage, every archive intro and every Tour Operator collapse title. Because the css field drops any rule containing `content:""`, the rule itself is drawn in assets/styles/core-heading.css.
